name: Run month end close checks and send a management pack with AI commentary

parameters.content:
## Run month end close checks and send a management pack with AI commentary

**Who it is for.** Finance teams closing the month by hand from a trial balance and a checklist.

**What it does**
- Runs on the second working day or on demand. Pulls this month's and last month's trial balance and the close data.
- Seven checks against a materiality figure: trial balance balances, bank reconciled, invoices posted, suspense cleared, VAT control agrees, fixed asset register agrees, receivables over 90 days reviewed.
- Builds the P&L against last month with the change on every line; an AI step drafts the commentary from the figures and the check results.
- Renders the management pack and distributes it, or BLOCKS the close and sends the failed checks instead.

**Setup**
1. Set base, period and materiality in Config, or replace the HTTP Request nodes with your accounting system (Zoho Books, QuickBooks Online, Xero) nodes.
2. Set the AI credential on the commentary step. Point distribution at your email or Slack node.
3. Activate; the schedule runs on the second working day.

All external systems are reached through HTTP Request nodes against `base` in the Config node, so the whole flow imports and runs against any REST backend; swap any of them for the native n8n node of your system. Built and tested on sample data by Finamatik: https://finamatik.com/work/month-end-close-pack

**Requirements.** n8n 1.100 or later; for the AI steps, a model endpoint at `base`/llm/complete or the OpenAI or Anthropic node in its place; your own systems reachable over HTTPS.

**How to customise.** Every rule lives in one Code or Config node and is named for what it decides; change the thresholds there, not in the branches.

={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: $("Config").first().json.finance_channel, text: "Close " + $("Assemble pack").first().json.period + " BLOCKED: " + $("Assemble pack").first().json.checks.filter(c => c.result === "FAIL").map(c => c.check + " (" + c.detail + ")").join("; ") + ". Draft pack: " + $json.url }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: $("Config").first().json.finance_channel, text: "Close " + $("Assemble pack").first().json.period + " " + $("Assemble pack").first().json.status + ". Pack: " + $json.url + ". Notes: " + $("Assemble pack").first().json.checks.filter(c => c.result === "WARN").map(c => c.check).join(", ") }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ channel: "email", to: $("Config").first().json.owner_email, body: "Management pack " + $("Assemble pack").first().json.period + " attached. " + $("Assemble pack").first().json.commentary.join(" "), attachment: $("Render management pack (xlsx)").first().json.url }) }}

const a = $('Assemble pack').first().json; const pack = $('Render management pack (xlsx)').first().json;
return [{ json: { period: a.period, status: a.status, checks: a.checks.map(c => c.check + ': ' + c.result), pack_url: pack.url, pack_sheets: pack.sheets } }];

parameters.content:
## Setup in three steps

1. Open **Config** and set `base` and the ledger, AR and AP endpoints, or swap the HTTP Request nodes for your accounting system's nodes.
2. Point the commentary step at your model endpoint (`base`/llm/complete) or swap it for the OpenAI or Anthropic node.
3. Set the schedule to your close day and activate.

Run it once on last month's data and compare the pack with the one you produced by hand.
